customer: Hello, I'm hoping to trade in my midsize SUV toward something bigger, but I just noticed the title still has my maiden name on it while my driver's license shows my married name. Could you please tell me what I'd need to bring so this doesn't hold things up? Thank you so much!
agent: Thanks for checking ahead, that's no problem at all. Since the name changed after marriage, please bring your marriage certificate to the appointment, along with your photo ID, and you'll sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, while you're here. If you ever spot a spelling mistake on the title, that needs to be corrected by your state's motor vehicle agency first, and if an ex-spouse is still listed as an owner, our article "My ex is still on the title" covers what to do.
